messages:
sophia: Quick follow-up from last night's partial-streaming hiccups — postmortem is up: https://redwood.internal/pm/385001. Main ask: we need owners + concrete timelines for remediation items by EOD Thu.

miguel: saw the postmortem, thanks. I'm volunteering to own the SDK reconnect backoff changes.

oliver: I can take the server-side heartbeat jitter and monitoring work. Plan: add per-session jittered heartbeats + metric for consecutive heartbeat gaps. ETA: 3 working days.

anya: can we prioritize the client fix first? most customers hit the partial responses due to client reconnect timing.

miguel: Agree. I'll aim for a patch tomorrow (small semver bump). Will add tests for reconnect windows.

infra-bot: Incident 385001 opened: streaming-partial-response-2026-03-21. Owners: TBD.

rachel: I'll own the rollout plan for Dedicated — need a canary across 10% of traffic then monitor error-rate for 6 hours. Target: Friday morning.

oliver: For the heartbeat metric I'll add a new prometheus exporter label 'session_loss_reason' so we can break out network vs kernel backpressure.

anya: Miguel, can you also add a client-side safety: if no token stream after X ms switch to polling fallback? Keep it configurable.

miguel: yes — design note: default fallback threshold 12s, configurable per request. Will include feature flag so we can toggle.

sophia: action items summary pls (one-liners) so we can paste into the postmortem follow-up doc.

miguel: ACTION: SDK reconnect/backoff + polling fallback (owner: miguel) — PR by Thu EOD, canary Fri AM.

oliver: ACTION: Server heartbeat jitter + session_loss_reason metric (owner: oliver) — PR by Wed EOD, deploy Thu.

rachel: ACTION: Dedicated rollout plan + canary gating (owner: rachel) — plan doc by Thu noon, execution Fri AM.

anya: ACTION: Add integration test that simulates delayed chunks and verifies fallback (owner: anya) — test by Thu EOD.

infra-bot: Reminder: weekly reliability sync on Mon at 11:00; consider adding these items to the agenda.

miguel: small code snippet I'll include in the SDK PR for the backoff change: 
```js
const backoff = jitteredExpBackoff({base: 200, cap: 10000});
await scheduleReconnect(backoff);
if (timeSinceLastChunk > fallbackMs) switchToPolling();
```

oliver: Also adding a server-side circuit-breaker that short-circuits retries after 3 immediate reconnect attempts to avoid thundering reconnections. Will put implementation notes in PR.

anya: We should also add an alert: "streaming.partial_responses.rate" — trigger if >0.5% for 10m. Who will own the alert tuning?

rachel: I'll tune the alert post-canary based on baseline. For now set it to 1% until metrics stabilize.

sophia: good. let's keep the update cadence tight: post progress in this thread daily until items closed. If blockers pop, tag @sre and @oncall.

miguel: PR link once ready. tagging @deploy-bot for canary.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled for 2026-03-26 08:00 UTC to 10% traffic (owner: rachel).

oliver: added prometheus config and a dashboard draft: /dashboards/streaming-session-loss. I'll share screenshots in the next message.

anya: one more ask — product wants a short customer-facing blurb if we enable polling fallback for some users. Sophia, can you coordinate comms?

sophia: yes, i'll draft one and share by Thu EOD.

rachel: I'll report canary metrics to this thread after 2h and 6h windows.

miguel: starting the SDK branch now. will update with PR by EOD.

sophia: thanks all. Recap: owners assigned, PRs + tests by Thu EOD where possible, server deploy and canary Fri AM. Daily check-ins here. :thumbsup:
